name: piloxa
description: Piloxa — the physical-mail action layer for AI agents. Prepare, purchase, send and track USPS Certified Mail to any U.S. address. Human approval is required before payment or mailing. One page is $15.97 with the Electronic Return Receipt, $12.97 with tracking only, $24.21 with the Evidence Pack or $50.10 as a Deadline Notice; up to 10 pages. Payment happens either on a review link, which always remains available, or, where the agent platform supplies a Stripe shared payment token, inside the agent after the person approves the exact total.
